Incumbent Governor Janet Napolitano was reelected in a landslide. Napolitano's widespread popularity contributed to her easy reelection; her general approval rating in October 2006, one month before the election, was at 58%.{{Cite web | url=http://www.surveyusa.com/50State2006/50StateGovernor061019State.htm |title = SurveyUSA {{pipe}} America's Neighborhood Pollster}} This was the last time until [[2022 Arizona gubernatorial election|2022]] that a Democrat was elected governor of Arizona.
